card.name: Mixed words in endothelin-antagonist and neonate text
card.fires_on: Scattered single words inside drug-label passages, such as 'left' before ventricular, 'large' before amounts, and 'with' after patients. The common thread is the setting (bosentan or macitentan labels, neonatal calcium warnings), not one word type.
